deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 2 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Base Board Feature Flags\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 2` output filtered to the `Base Board Feature Flags` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; selects Type 2 but searches the item label rather than the canonical decoded Features block, suppresses errors and omits record/bit provenance.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; correctly requires the complete approved flag set and reserved-bit policy but misclassifies software-controlled execution.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; treats the command as agent-runnable after variable provisioning but adds no field/bit validation.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Verify every asserted SMBIOS Type 2 Base Board Feature Flag for the intended board matches the approved board capabilities and reserved-bit policy and remains identical after reboot.
original_method: Archive complete Type 2 records, map the target board by identity/BOM/location, decode its feature-bit field into the full Features list, compare the ordered or set-normalized result and raw bit value with the approved baseline, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the target board, expected feature-bit set, reserved-bit interpretation and reboot plan. Core collection, decoding, comparison and persistence checking are automatable.
required_inputs: Reserved and unsupported bit policy for the applicable SMBIOS version
safety_requirements: Preserve complete Type 2 records and raw errors; do not treat a grep excerpt as the complete flag set.
Do not infer hardware capability merely because firmware asserts a feature flag.
Do not assume the first Type 2 record is the target board or silently ignore unknown/reserved bits.
Stop on ambiguous mapping, decode-version mismatch, flag drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete pre/post Type 2 records and tool/SMBIOS/BOM evidence, decode the target record's raw feature bits, normalize the full feature set and compare it with the approved baseline.
Do not modify DMI, substitute physical capability testing or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the target board, expected bit set, SMBIOS-version semantics and reserved-bit policy.
Determine whether any declared feature requires a separate functional test and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not directly applicable: `dmidecode` commonly renders this field as a `Features:` block rather than the literal item label, grep context may truncate a variable-length list, stderr is discarded and multiple board records are not disambiguated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the original command as provenance, but archive unfiltered `sudo dmidecode -t 2` output plus tool version/errors and use a record-aware parser to bind and decode the complete target-board feature field.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source Base Board Feature Flags scope, linked Type 2 script and 5/5-minute values are retained verbatim.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the raw Type 2 formatted section and, where supported by the approved tooling, the underlying record bytes; select the board record by correlated identity, decode every defined bit for the recorded SMBIOS version and compare raw plus normalized representations across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 2 systems, including multi-board server platforms.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS and board BOM revisions; interpret bits only against the applicable specification/revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 2 Base Board Information specification and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces fragile literal filtering with complete record capture, explicit bit semantics and board provenance while preserving the original field intent.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases visibility of omitted, unknown and reserved bits without replacing any functional capability test.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved expected bits, SMBIOS revision and target board mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS declarations are firmware metadata and do not by themselves prove that removable, replaceable or hot-swappable behavior works.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a platform-specific subset or supported absence only with the exact target board, SMBIOS revision and raw-bit mapping; it may not silently discard unknown or extra asserted bits.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected feature-bit set/reserved policy, board mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot all-Type-2 output plus raw and decoded target feature field
Approved reboot and host/management health evidence
Engineer verdict and any separate functional-coverage references

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Criteria consistently request Type 2 feature metadata correctness and reboot persistence. The display-label versus decoded-output-label difference is an extraction issue, not competing source intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The record field and safe read method are clear. Missing expected bits, board mapping or version semantics are project readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains the Type 2 read but rejects the literal-label grep and incomplete context as authoritative evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps complete-set, bit-semantics and recovery requirements while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates firmware-declared metadata validation from independent proof of the advertised physical feature and adds raw-bit/SMBIOS-version provenance.

review_improvement: Prevents empty or truncated evidence, wrong-board selection, and a declared metadata flag from being mistaken for proof that the physical capability functions.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once the expected bit map, target record and approved reboot plan are supplied, every core operation is software-controlled; user-supplied SPEC and approval affect readiness, not automation capability.
